content:
The long-awaited fourth season of Ted Lasso has returned (watch link), and Apple TV executive Eddy Cue recently hinted that the series has a very long and bright road ahead after this season.

Eddy Cue said that Ted Lasso still has "a lot of stories to tell," enough to support continued production in subsequent seasons.

Apple has not officially renewed Ted Lasso for a fifth season yet, but various signs suggest that, in addition to the currently airing fourth season, there will be at least two more seasons.

Deadline reported last year that the cast has signed a three-season contract, corresponding to the widely rumored three-season story blueprint in Jason Sudeikis's mind.

With the return of the series, Eddy Cue, Apple's Senior Vice President of Services, was asked about the possibility of a fifth season and longer-term development.

In a red carpet interview with ScreenRant, Cue discussed the possibility of a fifth season of Ted Lasso, saying:

Although Cue did not explicitly confirm any plans, he essentially said that Apple is committed to continuing the story of Ted Lasso for as long as possible.

This news is not surprising, but it is still encouraging to hear. Hopefully it means we still have a long time before we have to say goodbye to these characters.

Season 4 of Ted Lasso airs new episodes every Wednesday from today until October 7, with the first two episodes now available on Apple TV.

Are you excited about the return of Ted Lasso? What are your impressions of the new season? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.

Apple TV subscription is $12.99 per month, and can also be subscribed through the Apple One bundle offer.
